title: Narcissism in the United States: 5 Facts Behind the Label
description:
Narcissism in the United States is more complicated than a label for someone who hurts you. This five-part countdown explains America's rank of 16th among 53 countries for surveyed narcissistic traits, then separates those traits from an estimated 1%–2% prevalence of narcissistic personality disorder. We unpack the historical 6.2% lifetime estimate, explain why it cannot establish a rise or decline, and examine the 40.0% anxiety overlap in that older research. Finally, we put broader personality-disorder treatment figures in context without presenting them as NPD statistics.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
